title: Security Operations suite: Exposure Management, Threat Management, Red Canary MDR, managed threat hunting and CTEM

prose.text: {{suite-brand}} Whether EASM is a component of the suite rather than a standalone product is open {{gap:easm-placement}}.

{{exposure-components}} The Data Fabric page names Asset Exposure Management and Unified Vulnerability Management among the Exposure Management portfolio products [[portfolio.platform:dfs-exposure]]; which products make up the portfolio is open {{gap:exposure-members}}. {{uvm-ctem}} What the CTEM program spans is open {{gap:ctem-scope}}.

Whether CTEM stages map onto the suite's products is open {{gap:ctem-stages}}. Whether customers buy CTEM as a bundle is open {{gap:ctem-bundle}}. Whether CTEM has an SDK of its own is open {{gap:ctem-sdk}}.
The product entries are [[aem.overview]], [[uvm.overview]], [[risk360.overview]] and [[easm.findings]]; the shared data layer is in [[portfolio.secops-platform]].

Whether managed threat hunting targets TTPs that automated detection misses is open {{gap:mth-scope}}. Whether it is the human-expertise component within Red Canary MDR is open {{gap:mth-within-mdr}}. Whether it is delivered only as a managed service through the account team is open {{gap:mth-delivery}}.
{{red-canary-combined}} Whether Red Canary operates as a separate business unit within Zscaler is open {{gap:red-canary-unit}}.
Integration with the rest of the suite is open {{gap:red-canary-integration}}, and so is any customer SDK or delivery model {{gap:red-canary-delivery}}.

Identity Protection, SOC Workbench and Breach Predictor are in [[identity-protection.overview]], [[soc-workbench.overview]] and [[breach-predictor.overview]]. Agentic SecOps is described in [[portfolio.platform]].

checks.do: For a question about which SecOps product fits a need, route to that product's overview and answer from its claims; the suite page only groups the products.
For Red Canary delivery or integration questions, say the answer is open and do not infer an SDK, portal or account process.
For CTEM stage mapping, say the mapping is open and do not assign suite products to CTEM stages.

suite-brand.statement: The security operations page says Zscaler connects exposure management and threat management in a single platform, and that Zscaler Agentic SecOps applies unified threat and exposure management, zero trust telemetry, agentic workflows and closed-loop enforcement to transform security operations.

quotes: We help security teams eliminate blind spots by connecting exposure management and threat management in a single platform.
Zscaler Agentic SecOps applies unified threat and exposure management, unique zero trust telemetry, agentic workflows, and closed-loop enforcement to transform security operations.

exposure-components.statement: The page's Exposure Management tab says Zscaler Exposure Management correlates data across Zscaler telemetry and third-party security tools to maintain a trusted asset inventory, prioritize critical exposures with business context and orchestrate AI-driven remediation workflows, and lists its key offerings as Complete Asset Inventory, Unified Exposure Prioritization, KPI and SLA Reporting, AI-Powered Remediation Workflows, Identity Risk Visibility and SOC Alert Prioritization with Exposure Context.

evidence.after: ### Know all your assets and identities. Fix your gaps. Reduce your risk.
quotes: Zscaler Exposure Management correlates data across Zscaler telemetry and third-party security tools to maintain a trusted asset inventory, prioritize critical exposures with business context, and orchestrate AI-driven remediation workflows to hit SLA targets.
SOC Alert Prioritization with Exposure Context

uvm-ctem.statement: The UVM marketing page's Product Details include a CTEM accelerator section that says "Build and scale your continuous threat exposure management program with ease."

quotes: ### CTEM accelerator Build and scale your continuous threat exposure management program with ease.

threat-components.statement: The page's Solution Details tabs are Agentic SOC, Deception, Exposure Management, Threat Hunting and Managed Detection and Response; it describes Deception as realistic decoys and lures spanning endpoints, cloud, identity and AI environments.

quotes: Solution Details Agentic SOC Deception Exposure Management Threat Hunting Managed Detection and Response

Stop AI attacks with Deception. The realistic decoys and lures span endpoints, cloud, identity, and AI environments to create a blanket of tripwires that autonomous AI agents or human adversaries can’t help but trigger.

mth-hunting.statement: The page's Threat Hunting tab says Zscaler Threat Hunting leverages first-party ZIA telemetry to reveal covert adversary behavior hiding inside trusted traffic, and lists Continuous Expert-Led Hunting: 24/7 proactive hunting for anomalies and advanced threats across internet and SaaS traffic.

quotes: Zscaler Threat Hunting leverages first-party Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) telemetry to reveal covert adversary behavior hiding inside trusted traffic.
Continuous Expert-Led Hunting 24/7 proactive hunting for anomalies and advanced threats across internet and SaaS traffic.

red-canary-combined.statement: The page says that in Zscaler Managed Detection & Response its team, fusing Red Canary MDR operational intelligence with Zscaler inline telemetry, validates complex threats, drives rapid investigations and executes guided containment around the clock, and lists AI + Human Expert Triage: automated enrichment and investigation while experts handle advanced attacks and escalation.

quotes: Close operational coverage gaps with Zscaler Managed Detection & Response. Fusing Red Canary MDR operational intelligence with Zscaler inline telemetry, our team validates complex threats, drives rapid investigations, and executes guided containment around the clock.
AI + Human Expert Triage Automate enrichment and investigation while experts handle advanced attacks and escalation.

ctem-stages.title: How the five CTEM stages map onto the suite's products
ctem-stages.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'The five-stage CTEM model (scoping, discovery, prioritization, validation, mobilization) maps onto Zscaler's suite roughly as: AEM scopes and discovers, UVM prioritizes, Deception validates, Risk360 reports up.' No captured page gives a five-stage CTEM model or this mapping.

ctem-bundle.title: Whether customers buy CTEM as a multi-product bundle
ctem-bundle.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Customers buy the program (typically as a multi-product bundle within Security Operations) rather than a single discrete offering.' No captured page describes how CTEM is purchased.

mth-within-mdr.title: Whether Managed Threat Hunting sits inside Red Canary MDR
mth-within-mdr.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Managed Threat Hunting is distinct from but complementary to Red Canary MDR (Red Canary is the broader MDR layer; MTH is the specialized human-expertise component within it).' The security operations page has separate Threat Hunting and Managed Detection and Response tabs and does not nest one in the other.

mth-scope.title: Whether managed threat hunting targets TTPs that automated detection misses
mth-scope.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Proactive search for sophisticated threats, anomalies, and TTPs that automated detection misses.' The security operations page says Zscaler's threat hunters search for living-off-the-land techniques, abused RMM tools and stolen session tokens, and lists 24/7 proactive hunting for anomalies and advanced threats (claim mth-hunting); it does not say the hunting targets what automated detection misses.

mth-delivery.title: How managed threat hunting is delivered and engaged
mth-delivery.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Pure managed-service delivery: no portal configuration surface, no SDK; customer engagement is via the Zscaler account team.' The security operations page describes 24/7 expert-led hunting and names no engagement path.

red-canary-integration.title: How Red Canary MDR integrates with the rest of the suite
red-canary-integration.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Integration semantics with the rest of the SecOps suite are still emerging at capture date; Red Canary's standalone product surfaces remain operational.' The security operations page says Zscaler Managed Detection & Response fuses Red Canary MDR operational intelligence with Zscaler inline telemetry (claim red-canary-combined) and that Zscaler's AI agents fuse insights from Red Canary MDR operations, and gives no further integration semantics.

red-canary-delivery.title: Whether Red Canary MDR has a customer SDK or portal surface
red-canary-delivery.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'No customer SDK surfaced specifically for Red Canary; managed-service-shaped delivery.' A search of the vendored code found no Red Canary mention; the captured pages describe it as a service and name no interface.

ctem-sdk.title: Whether CTEM has an SDK surface of its own
ctem-sdk.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'No SDK — program-level offering; the SDK surfaces of the underlying products are what's accessible.' The UVM page describes a CTEM accelerator for a continuous threat exposure management program (claim uvm-ctem) and names no API or SDK for CTEM; the underlying products' surfaces are in their own subjects.

easm-placement.title: Whether EASM is positioned as a component of the Security Operations portfolio rather than a standalone product
easm-placement.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'The product URL https://www.zscaler.com/products-and-solutions/external-attack-surface-management redirects to this Security Operations page, indicating EASM is positioned as a component of the broader Security Operations / Exposure Management portfolio rather than a standalone product page.' The earlier non-verbatim capture of the security operations page added this note of its own; the current capture of the page does not mention EASM.

exposure-members.title: Which products make up Zscaler's Exposure Management portfolio
exposure-members.detail: Unverified legacy statement: the security operations page listed Asset Exposure Management, Unified Vulnerability Management, Risk360 and CTEM under Exposure Management, and the Data Fabric for Security page named EASM, Risk360 and Unified Vulnerability Management as the Exposure Management portfolio. Earlier non-verbatim captures of those pages said this; the current captures do not. The current security operations page names no products in its Exposure Management tab (claim exposure-components), and the current Data Fabric page names Asset Exposure Management and Unified Vulnerability Management among the portfolio products it powers today (portfolio.platform:dfs-exposure).

ctem-scope.title: What Zscaler's CTEM program spans
ctem-scope.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) — scalable program spanning assets, data, identity, cloud, SaaS.' The earlier non-verbatim capture of the security operations page listed this under Exposure Management; the current capture of the page does not mention CTEM. The UVM page describes a CTEM accelerator for building and scaling a continuous threat exposure management program (claim uvm-ctem).

red-canary-unit.title: Whether Red Canary MDR operates as a separate business unit within Zscaler
red-canary-unit.detail: Unverified legacy statement: 'Post-acquisition, Red Canary MDR functions as an AI-powered augmentation for SOC teams. Operates initially as a separate business unit within Zscaler.' The earlier non-verbatim capture of the security operations page said this; the current capture of the page names Red Canary only as a source of MDR operational intelligence and of insights for its AI agents, and does not describe its organizational status.
